description_en: The temple located at the crossroads of Mahapal had three roofs until the earthquake of 1934, but now only one, which is made of gold-coated copper, is left. This temple stands on four carved columns (each 18cm x 18cm), and its hinter wall is attached to an adjacent building.The door of the entrance in the southern facade has two small lattice windows (ṭikijhyāḥ) on either side. The circumambulatory plinth has been encroached upon by the buildings on the west and north sides. The entry has a shallow plinth of 15cm and is flanked by two guardian lions. The timberwork on the door, like the columns, the lattice windows and the door, is clad in brass sheets. A colour has been applied to the brass that makes it imitative of gold plating. The cornice ofnāgoandpalesvāis also clad with a brass repoussé. The upper lines of the cornice,dhalimvaḥandchuvā,are uncovered. The walls on the first floor (with the exception of the back wall) have small latticed windows at their centre; the interior rear wall is clad in granite. The four-waydhalipāhkāsloped roof is supported by carved struts, and has also been encroached upon by the adjacent building at the northwest corner. The two struts that should be at the northern side are missing. The eave boards are covered with decorative metal frills and adorned with wind bells (phaygã). The pinnacle, with a single foldãvaḥsāḥand topped by an umbrella is supported on a rectangular base (bhãgī)The main sanctum is 50cm beneath the plinth level, and the main deity of the temple is a stone statue of Gaṇeśa. He sits in the sanctum, wearing a gold-coated copper crown. This image of Gaṇeśa is not at the centre, but rather offset to the right. There is one small stone image of a sitting lion on either side of Gaṇeśa’s image. A large Śivaliṅga can also be found west if the main deity in the sanctum. The temple has threetoraṇas: one is above the entrance and two are inside the temple just above the image of Gaṇeśa. In thetoraṇa, above the main entrance at the top of the arc is an image of Garuḍa, and just below is an image of Gaṇeśa together with his consort, which flanked by two Nṛtyeśvaras. The uppertoraṇas inside the sanctum resembles thetoraṇaabove the entrance. The only difference is that one of thesetoraṇas contains an image of Gaṇeśa in standing posture without his consort; on the thirdtoraṇais an image of Gaṇeśa flanked by two Nṛtyeśvaras. Images of Aṣṭamātṛkās are carved into the struts.There are four rows of stepped oil-lamp balustrades on both sides of the main entrance. On the northern side of the temple, a bell hangs on a stone beam supported by two stone pillars. At the puttee under the temple’s brass pinnacle, one can read the following text:śrī 3 māhārājā yuddha samsera jaṅgabāhādura rāṇā(thrice venerable great king Yuddha Śamśera Jaṅgabahādura Rāṇā), which suggests that the temple was reconstructed under Juddha Śamśera's reign, after the 1934 earthquake.
description_ne: यो गणशमन्दिर महापालको चौबाटो नजिकै रहेको छ । हाल मन्दिरमा सुनको जलप लगाइएको तामाले बनेको एउटा मात्र छाना छ, तर सन् १९३४ को भूकम्प भन्दा अघि मन्दिरको तीन वटा छाना थिए । मन्दिर एउटा मात्र पेटीमाथि बनाइएको छ । मन्दिरको एउटा मात्र ढोका दक्षिणतर्फ फर्किएको छ र ढोकाको दुबै छेउमा सिंहका प्रतिमा रहेका छन् । मन्दिरको दक्षिणी मोहडा र ढोका सुनको जलप लगाइएको तामाद्वारा मोडिएको छ । मन्दिरको वायव्य कोणमा रहेको व्यक्तिगत घर मन्दिरसँग यसरी टाँसिएको छ कि त्यता तर्फको मन्दिरको छानोको केही भाग नै त्यो घरले छोपेको छ ।मन्दिरको मुख्य देवताको रूपमा मन्दिरको गर्भगृहमा गणेशको शिलाको मूर्ति रहेको छ जसको शिरमा सुनको जलप लगाइएको तामाको मुकुट छ । गणेशको दुई छेउमा बसेका सिंहका दुई प्रतिमा छन् । मन्दिरभित्र एउटा शिवलिङ्ग पनि रहेको छ । मन्दिरमा जम्मा तीन वटा तोरण रहेका छन्: एउटा मन्दिरको मूल द्वारमाथि र दुई वटा गणेशको मूर्तिको ठीक माथि । मूल द्वारमाथि रहेको तोरणमा माथिल्लो भागमा गरुडको प्रतिमा छ भने तल्लो भागमा बीचमा आफ्नी सहचरीको साथमा बसेका गणेश र दुई छेउमा नृत्येश्वरका प्रतिमा छन् । मन्दिरभित्र रहेका दुई तोरणमध्ये माथिल्लो तोरण बाहिरको तोरण जस्तै छ, फरक यत्ति मात्र छ कि भित्रको तोरणमा गणेशकी सहचरी छैनन् र गणेश आलीढ मुद्रामा उभिएका छन् । तेस्रो तोरणमा गणेश नृत्य मुद्रामा छन् र उनको दुई छेउमा नृत्येश्वरहरू छन् । मन्दिरका टुँडालहरूमा अष्टमातृकाका प्रतिमाहरू कुँदिएका छन् र हरेक टुँडालका तल्लो भागमा सम्भोगरत प्रतिमाहरू कुँदिएका छन् । मन्दिरको गजुर सुनको जलप लगाइएको तामाको छ । मन्दिरको मूल द्वारको दुवै छेउमा चार तह भएका दीपावलि राखिएका छन् । मन्दिरको उत्तरतर्फको पेटीमा ढुंगाको स्तम्भमाथि ढुंगाकै बलोमा झुण्ड्याइएको घण्टा छ । मन्दिरको गजुरमुनिको पट्टिमा र छानाको झल्लरमा श्री ३ महाराज युद्धसम्सेर जङ्गबहादुर राणा लेखिएको छ, यसबाट जुद्ध सम्सेरको शासनकालमा सन् १९३४ को भूकम्पपछि मन्दिरको पुनर्निर्माण गरिएको थियो भन्ने जानकारी पाइन्छ ।

historical_events.event_description: Turaśirāma Bhāro installed an object in the Gaṇeśa temple.
Tulasīlāla Śreṣṭha donated four rows of stepped oil-lamps, which are installed on both sides of the entrance of the temple.

historical_events.event_name: Marble fixed on inner wall and floor of the temple
historical_events.event_description: Sundara Nārāyaṇa Jośī made a donation to fix the marble.
Kabiramāna Amātya made a donation to fix the iron gate.
